purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and visual continuity controls for the Brasswater Reserve House call-right hearing.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for the weekly reserve count, disputed Deep Company wagon, public constituency hearing, final winter priority, and state-gated aftermaths.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for the two-level establishing view, constituency introduction, each ordinary count choice, routine fold, train arrival, each cargo action, hearing fold, each constituency bargain, final threshold, and each ending family. The mould assay reveal and the final whole-room threshold receive their own replay frames.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt restates the visible room geometry, materials, light, props, and every visible character in plain visual language. Continuity notes are reviewer constraints only. Prompt assembly adds the global style cue, then only the visual refs for characters visible in that frame, then triggered modifiers.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: richly textured high-fantasy industrial storybook illustration, precise dark ink linework, restrained gouache and watercolor, carved basalt and worn brass, amber oil lamps against cold blue runic light, readable silhouettes, humane facial acting, practical heavy machinery, unlettered surfaces, cinematic composition designed for illustrated interactive fiction.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble every generated prompt from global_style_cue, the selected scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for visible named characters or groups, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Keep visual_continuity_notes outside the assembled prompt. Use the scene_set camera blockout as visual input before multi-angle rendering.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide cutaway establishing view of a two-level fantasy-industrial reserve house carved as a long wedge in dark basalt. On the lower floor, an iron freight rail enters a tall north arch, crosses a blue-rune-lit weighbridge, then exits a south export arch; a switch forks west toward three barred crystal storage cells. On the upper east wall, a public counting gallery overlooks the rails behind a waist-high bronze safety rail, with a large service-days gauge, black slate, heavy seal desk, small brass assay niche, yellow queue line, and stone stair descending at the south end. Amber oil lamps warm worn brass and wet stone while cold blue runes shine under the track. Dwarf householders in winter work clothes hold bread and copper service tokens behind the yellow line; rail hands in orange coats stand near the lower brake line.

visible_characters.default_stance: householders and protected-service workers queue behind the yellow line while rail crews occupy the lower brake line

visual_continuity_notes: The lower track runs north to south. The municipal siding branches west toward three cells. The upper public gallery occupies the east wall and connects to the lower bay only by the south stone stair.
The service-days gauge, public ledger, seal desk, assay niche, switch lever, yellow line, weighbridge, brake roster, and barred cells retain fixed positions.
